sources.S1400_note: approximate: Sgr A* is confused with Sgr A West at 21 cm and heavily scattered; spectrum S ~ nu^+0.3 from ~1 to ~100 GHz, ~1 Jy at 43 GHz, 2.4 Jy at 230 GHz (EHT 2022)

var.nir_note: Genzel+2003, Do+2019: several flares/day, 1-2 h long, up to 10-100x quiescent

qpo_min.note: claimed ~17-22 min quasi-periodicity (Genzel+2003; GRAVITY 2018 orbital motion ~45 min); disputed

sources.t_isco_note: 2 pi sqrt(r^3/GM) for r = 6 GM/c^2, a Schwarzschild 4.15e6 Msun hole: ~31 min; for prograde orbits round a spinning hole it can be ~4-30 min
